The sentence "Either the players or the coach have to address the media after the game" contains a subject-verb agreement error. When using the correlative conjunction "either...or," the verb should agree with the subject closest to it. In this case, the closest subject is "the coach," which is singular. Therefore, the verb should be "has" instead of "have."

Corrected sentence: Either the players or the coach has to address the media after the game.
